description: Turn a GitHub issue into a tested fix on a branch with an open PR: read the issue as the contract, find the root cause, write the failing test first, fix, prove it, review the diff against the issue, push and open the PR only after GO. Merging stays with pb-ship. Use for "fix issue 42", "bug fix from this issue", "turn this issue into a PR".
